name: Tashuzokukan Mondai Kaiketsu Iinkai 2
original_name: 多種族間問題解決委員会(2)
source:
Due to a specific event that occurred on a global scale,
a variety of species from different worlds are living on earth.
There are problems between various species, and to remedy this
the [Multi-Species Relations Problem Solving Committee] was created.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE255656.html]DLsite English[/url]]
